prompt: What was the full three-word name of the crystal that the gnome who piloted the airship in the motion simulator Questor, which first opened at Busch Gardens Williamsburg in 1990, was seeking as the ultimate goal of his expedition?
answer: The crystal was the **Crystal of Zed**.
